basic_info.description: HUGE VALUE! Move right in to this fresh & airy 1-bedroom condo with parking & storage in the vibrant Mission! The spacious unit is quietly situated at the back-side of the building overlooking a tranquil shared courtyard. A sleek slate-floor kitchen with new appliances beckons you to entertain as you flow into the open-concept oversized living/dining room with ample space for an at-home office. There is a large private & bright bedroom with great closet space. A freshly remodeled magazine-worthy bathroom with tub & shower complete this turn-key condo. This Green building has roof solar panels, high-speed internet and an elevator. Common laundry room and multiple courtyards make this a cozy building with great action at your fingertips as you explore the neighborhood. Just blocks from local hot spots as Gus's Community Market, Tartine Manufactory, Valencia Corridor and close to BART and 101 access - you have city life awaiting you! Walk Score of 100 and Bike Score 100! Several photos are virtually staged.
